title: Inbound Risk Early-Warning Agent
outcome: Flags late inbound shipments in transit; critical band 97% precise in backtest.
summary: Delayed or lost inbound shipments were noticed too late, often by the customer. A transparent 0-100 risk score with plain-word reasons, Teams alerts and a Copilot Studio agent warns the control tower while there is still time to act.
cv: Inspired by: inbound-risk dashboard sustaining 99% on-time through COVID-19; lost-shipment postcode analysis cutting lost shipments 64%.

cards.title: 300 shipments, scored every 30 minutes
cards.caption: Each in-transit shipment gets a 0-100 score from seven weighted factors, sorted by risk and filterable by customer and carrier.
cards.alt: Inbound risk monitor listing shipments by score with critical, at risk and watch tags and KPI tiles

cards.title: Architecture
cards.caption: A scheduled flow pulls tracking events, an Azure Function scores them, Dataverse stores scores and reasons, Teams, Copilot Studio and Power BI use them.
cards.alt: Architecture diagram from TMS events through Power Automate and Azure Function to Dataverse, Teams, Copilot Studio and Power BI

cards.title: Every point is explainable
cards.caption: Each factor is a straight line between no concern and full concern, times a fixed weight. Weights sum to 100.
cards.code:
return {
        "lane": clamp01((f["lane_delay_rate"] - 0.06) / 0.24),
        "area": clamp01((f["area_loss_rate"] - 0.004) / 0.016),
        "carrier": clamp01((0.95 - f["carrier_on_time"]) / 0.20),
        "dwell": clamp01((ratio - 1.0) / 2.0),
        "customs": 1.0 if f["customs_status"] == "held" else 0.5 if f["customs_status"] == "pending" else 0.0,
        "slack": clamp01((1.0 - slack) / 2.0),
        "calendar": cal,
    }

cards.title: Reasons and a Teams alert

cards.alt: Shipment detail with ranked reasons, factor bars and a Teams adaptive card preview with Acknowledge, Draft customer update and Escalate buttons

cards.title: GitHub Copilot ready
cards.caption: Code drafted with AI pair programming and verified by 28 pytest tests and a parity check on all 300 risk scores. The repo ships GitHub Copilot custom instructions (brand, British English, synthetic data only, tests first), so every follow-up change in Copilot Chat or agent mode works to the same rules.
